title: Mixed Event — Warmth in Every Stitch — Episode7 Gifts from the Heart

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku feels grateful for all of Mafuyu's help with studying and club activities, and wants to do something in return. When she learns that Mafuyu is looking for ways to improve her home ec project, she offers some embroidery lessons.

rows.Line: The day before Valentine's Day
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The interfacing seems to be adhering nicely, so we shouldn't need to worry about the threads fraying.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That concludes my final checks.
Very nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay, we're done!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't help but feel a sense of accomplishment after seeing how many gifts we made.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I feel the same way.
I'm really looking forward to handing these out to everyone tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure they're going to love these, since you all worked so hard on them.
bgm_area00002
Valentine's Day
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This is incredible, Airi!
I didn't realize you knew how to make mousse cakes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And it's in the shape of a really cute heart!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Just wait until you taste it.
Also, I went with a low-calorie recipe, so feel free to have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you brought spoons with chocolates on top of them, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! They're called chocolate spoons, and all you have to do is pour melted chocolate onto the bowls. It's really easy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And they're all decorated differently.
Did you choose the dragées for these based on our colors?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think that also goes for the other toppings. Between the hearts and flowers, it's really easy to tell which spoon belongs to whom♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... I did my best to make sure you guys like how they all look!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for putting so much thought into these, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, would it alright if we showed you all our gifts next?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our gifts? Did you make them together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Shizuku taught me how to make mine, so they probably won't look as good as hers... But I hope you guys like them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, Minori, I'll start with yours...
This is for you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ohmygosh!
Th-This pouch is for me?!
But it's so beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, these flowers are so pretty!
Did you embroider them yourself, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, because Minori's smile has a way of making others around her feel better. Like flowers that suddenly start blooming.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I decided to embroider a whole flower field inspired by her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's like a field of flowers just popped up around Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, talk about a flowery smile.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thank you so much, Haruka...! I promise to treasure this pouch and what you just said forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm glad to hear that you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next, Airi, I'd like to present you my gift.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
I'm starting to feel kinda nervous, after all that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Here you are.
Happy Valentine's Day, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Is this a keychain...?
Oh, it's an embroidered sun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, it's so pretty! Look at all the shiny beads and threads!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're always shining so brightly and illuminating us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I thought it was just perfect for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Your eyes are shining brightly too, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
H-Hey, cut me some slack.
Anyone would feel this way after receiving something like this...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shizuku...
I promise to make good use of this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Next, Len, would you mind?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No problem. I'll be the one presenting what we got for you and the others, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, Len, why you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because I helped them come up with embroidery designs for their gifts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, he provided us with some wonderful ideas after thinking very hard about all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
Now I can't wait to see what you made.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Show us already, Len♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, Rin, I'll start with you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here you are.
Happy Valentine's Day, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Wow, this towel feels so fluffy and absorbent!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's embroidered with... My face, and some yellow flowers?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They're canola flowers.
Shizuku did your face, and I did the flowers.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Apparently, these flowers symbolize cheerful energy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's supposed to be you making all your fans smile while putting on a fun and happy performance.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks, Len...!
And you both, Shizuku, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm gonna use this towel to practice and put on shows that send everyone home smiling!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what kind of design did you come up for me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, MEIKO, for you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also made pouches for you two, Airi, Shizuku. I hope you both like them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also made keychains for you both. I'll hand them out now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, thanks so much...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that everyone's enjoying their gifts.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We put so much thought and effort into our gifts, and we get to see them all smile now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I couldn't be happier...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(This is the power of embroidery...
It has the ability to make these sorts of connections with others.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I hope things are going well on Asahina's end...)
